reportedIssues: The first two cards in 'Fastest near you' are exact duplicates: same name ('Green Bowl Poké'), same image, same '15–25 min' badge and same '€0.90 delivery' text. This looks like duplicated/placeholder data rather than real distinct restaurants.

Cards in 'Fastest near you' show only name and delivery fee, while 'Popular right now' cards include rating, time, and cuisine. The missing rating/cuisine metadata makes the top carousel feel incomplete and inconsistent.
